arn.text: Rabiah is a desert plane that the Thousandfold Refraction splits into a thousand and one planes, and in the process Taysir is copied only five times, once for each color.
Nailah seduces the black Taysir and has him kill and absorb the green one, and the Apprentice Taysir kills the Shepherd Taysir in Fa'adiyah at her command.
Nailah tries to force the Unification of Taysir, and Hajjaj tries to stop her and is seemingly killed, but he reveals he is alive and aids Raghib and the white Taysir against her.

The nomad Taysir defeats Nailah and merges with his last counterpart, becoming the most powerful wizard in the multiverse, and after he becomes a planeswalker he blasts her and leaves, while she bars him from returning.
